FactionColonies.CodexEntryDef.label: Prosperity
FactionColonies.CodexEntryDef.description:
Prosperity is a 0–100 stat on each settlement that directly multiplies all resource production.
At 50 prosperity, your settlement produces half as much as at 100. At 1, production is nearly zero.
Prosperity drifts daily toward a target calculated from your other social stats: Target = (Happiness + Loyalty + (100 − Unrest)) / 3
The drift rate is 1 point per day (plus any stat modifiers from policies, buildings, or events). If your happiness and loyalty are high and unrest is low, prosperity will climb. If social stats deteriorate, prosperity follows.
Losing a defensive battle costs 20 prosperity immediately, which can take many days to recover from.

FactionColonies.CodexEntryDef.label: Empire Threat Level (ETL)
FactionColonies.CodexEntryDef.description:
The Empire Threat Level (ETL) is a hidden multiplier (1.0x to 3.0x by default) that scales how dangerous enemy attacks are against your settlements.
It is a weighted composite of four factors: - Average settlement level (35% weight) - Highest settlement level (15% weight) - Faction income (30% weight) - Settlement count (20% weight)
Each factor follows a non-linear curve; early growth raises threat slowly, but large empires with high income hit the cap fast. Having one high-level settlement raises threat less than having many mid-level ones.
During your first year, a handicap limits how fast threat can grow regardless of your empire's strength. After one year, the cap transitions smoothly to ETL-based scaling.
The Max Threat Multiplier setting (default 3.0x) provides an absolute ceiling to ETL.
